ApiKeyHelp: In Emby: Settings > Advanced > API Keys > New API Key. Without a key you can only see what is playing, but not control anything.
DeviceIdsHelp: Folder name under this instance or value of info.deviceId. Leave empty to show all devices.
IntroText: Enter the address of your Emby server and an API key, then save. Open an Emby app (TV, phone, browser): it appears in the object tree under this instance. Details and recommendations are in the README.
IP: Address of the Emby server with port, e.g. 192.168.0.100:8096
isSSLHelp: Only tick if you open Emby with https:// (e.g. behind a reverse proxy).
PollIntervalDesc: Keeps the last activity up to date and is needed for the automatic cleanup. Recommended: 60.
RemoveDeletedDevices: Remove devices deleted in Emby (Settings > Devices)
RemoveInactiveDaysDesc: Removes devices that have not been used for this long, e.g. old phones. Scripts and history settings on them are lost.
TimeoutDesc: Prevents the state from flickering between two episodes. Recommended: 500, increase if needed.
